scheme_name: Scheme for Wage Compensation to Handloom Weaver Families
other_conditions: Applicant must be the head of the family
Applicant must be enrolled under the Praja Sadhikara Survey of Andhra Pradesh
benefits_summary: Provides a subsistence allowance of ₹4,000 per weaver family annually (₹2,000 per month for two months) transferred via DBT.
documents_required: first page of the bank account passbook
